name: Settlement Condition Modification Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the status of a securities settlement condition modification request.

PACK.name: Acknowledged Accepted
PACK.definition: Instruction has been acknowledged/accepted by the account servicer.

REJT.name: Rejected
REJT.definition: Instruction has been rejected for further processing.

MODP.name: Pending
MODP.definition: Modification is pending. At this time, it is unknown whether the modification can be affected.

DEND.name: Denied
DEND.definition: Modification Request will not be executed.
